# College Decision

> College Decision helps students compare colleges in India using structured information about fees, programmes, eligibility, admission routes, locations, exams, and placement context.

Last updated: 2026-09-05

## Main pages

- [Home](/): Compare college fees, admission and placements in India, plus the best-fit college filter.
- [Articles](/articles): Published college comparison and admission guides.
- [Colleges](/colleges): Paginated directory of active colleges.
- [Courses](/courses): Paginated directory of courses with programme coverage.
- [Exams](/exams): Entrance exams mapped to active college programmes.
- [Compare colleges 2026](/compare-colleges-2026): Side-by-side college comparison for fees, courses, placements and admission.
- [About](/about): About the College Decision platform.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact the College Decision team.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [Terms and conditions](/terms-and-conditions): Terms of use.
- [Disclaimer](/disclaimer): Data and decision-making disclaimer.

## Decision tool

Use the “Find My Best-Fit College” tool on the homepage to filter active programme records by course, state, city, budget, college type, branch or programme, and entrance exam.

## Data guidance

Displayed fees, eligibility, admission routes, and placement figures are structured reference data. They may vary by academic year or institution. Students should verify current details with the official college notice before applying.
